submitted.rationale: XRD at Sb 0.56, 0.68 and 0.77 showed the same trirutile ZnSb2O6-type pattern across the Sb-rich half. A second peak set (Q≈2.44 and 3.63) grew stronger as Sb rose. EQE came out at 0.0673% for Sb 0.804, 0.0701% for Sb 0.678 and 0.0858% for Sb 0.589, so it goes up as the film gets more Zn-rich. Index 13 was the highest of the three measured.
